content: Hi! Looking to bypass Roth IRA income limits?
Yes. We can’t use all our energy credits—can we sell them?

For 2023+ projects, **§6418** lets you **transfer certain IRA clean-energy credits** to an unrelated buyer for cash (tax-free to you). You should complete the IRS **pre-filing registration** to obtain registration numbers for each credit property.

1) Register projects in the IRS portal pre-filing and get **registration numbers**.
2) Execute a **credit transfer agreement** with the buyer.
3) On your return, make the **transfer election** for each credit and reduce your basis if required.
4) The buyer claims the credit on its **Form 3800/3468 series**, matching your registration numbers.

Maintain the registration confirmation, transfer contracts, placed-in-service certificates, and cost/eligibility support. Treat the cash proceeds as **non-taxable** under §6418 (not as income), and track any basis adjustments.
